verification.interpretation: Integrity checks do not certify translation quality, philosophical novelty, contest eligibility, or complete provider capture.

preservation.russian_retrospective: Removed from the current repository tree; original remains in runs/methodology-retrospective-20261012/. Earlier private Git history retains the earlier export.
preservation.original_prompts: Verbatim retained visible text; no grammatical cleanup or translation in place.
preservation.translations: English reading editions beside Russian originals; not versions evaluated during the midterm.
preservation.older_narrative_histories: Local originals and fingerprints retained. English biographies derive from the complete canonical structured biography entries; do not claim every historical prose HISTORY file was fully translated.
preservation.editorial_language: English, except original-language logs, attributed Russian quotations, and the five user-approved Russian-original essay lineages.

coverage.remaining_gap_surface: Tool records only; no unresolved conversational-text parser item in this export.
coverage.oversized_file_handling: Existing collector view reused under the established 64 MiB bounded capture limit.
coverage.excluded: Hidden reasoning, system/developer instructions, unrelated sessions, and unreviewed tool bodies. One temporary signed download-URL query excluded from Claude transport metadata; no human prompt altered.
coverage.boundary: Snapshot of accessible retained records, not whole-provider capture. Human prompts are distinct from user-role AI-dispatched research packets.
coverage.collector: Export-local recovery; no claim that the canonical background collector was globally repaired.

scope.future_public_release_choice: After deadline: publish this repository or export the full edition to a fresh public repository while retaining intermediate Git history privately.

transport.bounded_recovery: A GitHub tree batch exceeded the service request limit; remaining files were uploaded in smaller batches before the final tree and commit were verified.
